part.text:
Migration complete. `npx tsc --noEmit` and `next build` both pass.

**Mapping summary:**

| Pages Router | App Router |
|---|---|
| `pages/_app.js` + `_document.js` | `app/layout.tsx` (root layout, `metadata` API for description/icon, fonts via `<link>`, `AppProvider` + header/footer) |
| `pages/_error.js` | `app/error.tsx` (client `Error` boundary with `reset`) |
| `pages/404.js` | `app/not-found.tsx` (client component, `useRouter` from `next/navigation`) |
| `pages/index.js` (`getServerSideProps`) | `app/page.tsx` (async Server Component, `headers()` from `next/headers` for `userAgent`, `metadata` + `openGraph` exports, `dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`) |
| `pages/blog/index.js` (`getStaticProps` + `revalidate`) | `app/blog/page.tsx` (async Server Component, `export const revalidate = 60`) |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` (`getStaticPaths`/`getStaticProps`/`revalidate`/`notFound`/`router.isFallback`) | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` (`generateStaticParams`, `export const revalidate = 300`, `notFound()` from `next/navigation`, `generateMetadata`, async `params`) |
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts` (named `GET`/`POST`, `NextResponse.json`) |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` (named `GET`/`PUT`/`DELETE`, typed `params: Promise<{ id: string }>`) |
| `components/AppProvider.js` | `components/AppProvider.tsx` (typed `AppContextValue` + `'use client'`) |
| `<a href>` | `next/link` `Link` |
| `useRouter` from `next/router` | `useRouter` from `next/navigation` (extracted into `ViewAllPostsButton`, `ReadMoreButton`, `BackButton` client components to keep page files as Server Components) |
| `next/head` | `metadata` / `generateMetadata` |

Shared types live in `types/index.ts` (`Post`, `Comment`, `ApiPost`). The `pages/` directory has been removed.
